  data

  id = self&.to_i
  if id.nil?

  unless @pets.key?(id)

  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data

  data

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless false
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)

  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")

    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless id
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  if @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise("Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

  self[id] = data
  data
end

  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  nil
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end

  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets.fetch(id)
  data
end

end
